title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(田中泰司研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Tanaka Yasushi)
educationalGoal: Achieving following abilities to be a civil engineer (1) Be able to conduct experiments, analyses or surveys. (2) Be able to design, construct, and maintain infrastructure. (3) Be able to explain the processes and effects involved in infrastructure. (4) Be able to analyze social changes taking the future into consideration. (5) Be able to develop sustainable society.
advice: In the Tanaka laboratory, projects of structural mechanics, maintenance, or disaster prevention are carried out in Design Project III. A main theme will be proposed to each student by the instructor. Students will find problems related to the main theme as a first step. Second, they will conduct surveys. Then they will summarize their findings. Solutions will be conceived and implemented in accordance with plans formulated by the students themselves. In this course, each student proceeds with their project under the instruction of the supervisor. The following details the activities for each semester. First semester:Besides textbooks and lecture notes, students refer to specific papers and journals. By doing a literature survey, students review their basic knowledge of structural mechanics and reinforced concrete engineering. Then students make presentations outlining their theme, background on their project, and their project plan. Second semester:Projects planned in the first semester are carried out by individuals or teams to their conclusion. A minimum of 450 hours of learning time is required in this course. Preparation and review times shown in this syllabus are minimum values.
requiredKnowledge: Students need an understanding of Structural Mechanics I and II, Structural Mechanics Analysis, and Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain purpose of the subject selected by themselves.
Students can make plans to solve their chosen problems.
Students can conduct activities to solve their problems.
Students can analyze the results of their activities.
Students can summarize the achievement of project and to explain it clearly.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can conceive rational ideas about construction and infrastructure maintenance with the support of the instructor. Students can find methodologies to solve their chosen problems and conduct experiments, analysis and/or surveys appropriate to their methodology. Students can present the achievement of their projects to professionals and students. Students will always act in accordance with engineering ethics.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can conceive rational ideas about construction and infrastructure maintenance with the guidance of the instructor. Students can find methodologies to solve their chosen problems and conduct experiments, analysis and/or surveys based on the guidance of the instructor and master's students. Students can present their project achievements to professionals. Students will always act in accordance with engineering ethics.
